_source:
A real, complete 'Biology Form 2 Scheme of Work, Term 1-3' (a real Zambian secondary school's Natural Science Department; the source's own teacher name and school name are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy) was shared with this project and reviewed in full, covering all three terms. This is a genuine gap fill -- this app previously had no Biology Form 2 content at all (only Form 1 existed under the 2023 Competency-Based Curriculum). Topic, Sub-topic and Specific Competence statements are the source's own real wording; its own Content/Concept, Learning Activities, Strategies/Methods and Materials/Resources columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app. Term placement for every topic is real, read directly from which Term block of the source document it appears in -- no organizational guessing was needed since this one document covers the whole year. Where the same topic/sub-topic recurs across several consecutive real weeks with related but distinct specific competences (e.g. 2.2.4 Properties of Water covering both the properties themselves and their importance to the cell), those weeks' competences are kept as separate Specific Competence entries under the one sub-topic, rather than merged into one statement or repeated as duplicate sub-topics.

TERM 3 CROSS-CHECKED against a second, separate real document specifically for this term -- 'Biology Scheme of Work Form 2 Term 3' (the same real school's Natural Science Department) -- which independently confirms the same real topic set for Term 3 (2.5 Coordination and Response; 2.5.2 Health and Disease; 2.6 Ecological Relationships and Evolution: Classification of Organisms, Feeding Relationships and Energy Flow, Pollution) and additionally names the real official syllabus edition directly -- '2024 Biology Syllabus, Ordinary Secondary Education Form 1-4' -- citing pages 31-33 for this same content. The first (Term 1-3) document cites the same content at pages 23-26 without naming the syllabus edition. This page-number discrepancy between the two real, independently-authored documents is reproduced here transparently rather than silently resolved -- both real documents agree on the topic/competency content itself, only their own page citations differ. 2.4.2 Germination, Growth and Development in Plants (placed here at the start of Term 3, continuing on from Term 2's 2.4.1 Reproduction in Plants) appears only in the first (Term 1-3) document; the second, Term-3-specific document does not mention it at all, possibly because its own first week's content was lost to a text-extraction gap in that document -- reproduced here from the first document since it is the only one of the two that addresses it, and CDC's own Concept 4 (Continuity of Life) sequence logically continues from reproduction to germination and growth. Both documents' own 'Revision', 'Mid-Term Test', 'Continuous Assessment' and 'End of Year Examinations' weeks are administrative planning notes, not new curriculum content, and are therefore not encoded as topics here -- consistent with every other bundled subject in this app, where the calendar-pacing engine (not the source document) is what places the real Mid-Term Break and End-of-Term Examinations rows.
